items.quote: And I came this day unto the well
items.claim: A servant came to a well

items.quote: and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go
items.claim: A servant prayed to God requesting prosperity for his journey

items.quote: Behold, I stand by the well of water
items.claim: A servant stood at a well of water

items.quote: when the virgin cometh forth to draw water
items.claim: A virgin came forth to draw water

items.quote: and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink
items.claim: A servant requested water from a virgin to drink from her pitcher

items.quote: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels
items.claim: A virgin offered water to the servant and offered to draw water for his camels

items.quote: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master's son
items.claim: The LORD appointed a woman as a wife for Abraham's son
